Thanks — calendar invite received. Quick logistics ahead of Tue’s call:

Pre-read (links attached):
 - CAIQ coverage PDF: redwood_caiq_coverage.pdf (stub) — highlights where Redwood maps to CAIQ assertions and where we rely on cloud provider controls.
 - Intake folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bCobaltBridgeIntake (please drop any artifacts you want to share)

1) Point person for evidence handoff (name + email) — will be the primary contact for each evidence item.
2) Any strict blackout dates for data access or demo that we should be aware of.
3) If you want auditor included, flag now and we’ll allocate 10 extra minutes q&a for that line.

On our side we’ll bring:
- irene_choi (engineering compliance lead) — will take notes on evidence owners and technical clarifications
- david_kim (platform security) — will cover logs/storage/retention mapping

Draft intake outcomes we aim for by EOD Fri 12/18:
- Evidence ownership matrix populated (who owns which artifact)
- List of any control gaps and suggested remediation/compensating controls
- Timeline for artifact handoff (S3 links / upload window)

If anything changes, reply-all. Otherwise see you Tue 12/15 at 13:00 PST.

Best,
Maya

From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, samir@cobaltbridge.com
Cc: david_kim <david@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Meeting minutes — 12/15 CAIQ+SIG intake (actions & owners)

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 13:00:00 -0800, meeting held: CAIQ & SIG intake with CobaltBridge (recording: linked in Drive). Summary and action items below.

Attendees (redwood): Maya, Irene, David
Attendees (cobaltbridge): Samir, Elena + security ops engineer (J. Torres)

Key discussion points:
- Scope mapped: Redwood hosted inference (hosted API) + Dedicated pools. CobaltBridge indicated interest only in hosted + dedicated (no on-prem).
- Data residency: CobaltBridge requires EU-region data processing for EU customers; we walked through routing policies and region pinning options. David to provide exact routing config sample by 12/17.
- Logs: clarified retention windows (default 30 days for request logs; 365 days for audit logs in Dedicated). Samir requested proof-of-export for audit logs — action item below.
- Evidence: CobaltBridge will share SOC 2 report and redacted auditor letter; Redwood will provide CAIQ mapping and sample log export (redwood_caiq_coverage.pdf + sample_log_export.json stub).

Actions (owner — due):
1) Samir P. — share SOC 2 report and primary evidence contact (due 12/16).
2) David K. — provide routing configuration doc and example policy (due 12/17).
3) Irene C. — upload CAIQ coverage PDF and sample log export to Drive (done 12/15) and send final matrix template (done).
4) Maya S. — create evidence intake folder and schedule follow-up weekly cadence starting 12/20 (invite sent).

Attachments placed in Drive: redwood_caiq_coverage.pdf, sample_log_export.json (stub), intake_matrix_template.xlsx (stub)

Next sync: Weekly 30-min check-ins starting Mon 12/20 11:00 PST to track artifact collection. If any blocker on evidence extraction arises please flag in the shared Drive thread.

Thanks everyone — good kickoff.

Irene Choi
Engineering Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
